data.title: Long-Firm Credit Buildup Pattern — Steady Low Utilization Followed by Rapid Spike
data.description: Detects commercial accounts following a long-firm fraud pattern: steady low-value credit utilization for 6-12 months (building creditworthiness) followed by rapid escalation in credit utilization (the "burst"). Long-firm fraud involves organized criminal groups establishing businesses, building credit relationships, then exploiting that trust to defraud supply chain partners and trade finance banks. The artificially smooth buildup period followed by a discontinuous spike is the hallmark behavioral indicator.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Long-Firm Credit Buildup Pattern")`
`comment("Detects steady low utilization followed by rapid credit spike")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:commercial_credit account_type="commercial"
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(credit_utilization_pct) AS avg_util,
        max(credit_utilization_pct) AS max_util
  BY account_id, _time
| streamstats avg(avg_util) AS trailing_6m_avg,
              current=false window=6
  BY account_id
| streamstats latest(avg_util) AS prev_month_util,
              current=false window=1
  BY account_id
| where trailing_6m_avg < 35 AND avg_util > 80 AND prev_month_util < 50
| sort - avg_util
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Long-Firm Credit Buildup Pattern
WITH monthly_util AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_date) AS month,
        AVG(credit_utilization_pct) AS avg_util
    FROM commercial_credit_accounts
    WHERE account_type = 'commercial'
    GROUP BY account_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_date)
),
trend AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        month,
        avg_util,
        LAG(avg_util, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_util,
        AVG(avg_util) OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month
            ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS trailing_6m_avg
    FROM monthly_util
)
SELECT account_id, month, avg_util, trailing_6m_avg, prev_month_util
FROM trend
WHERE trailing_6m_avg < 35
  AND avg_util > 80
  AND prev_month_util < 50
ORDER BY month DESC

references: UNODC, Organized Fraud — Issue Paper (Vienna, 2024) — Chapter II, Fraud Against Businesses
UK SFO, Serious Fraud Office secures three convictions in $500 million trade finance fraud, 2 February 2023
falsepositives: Seasonal businesses with legitimate cyclical credit utilization spikes
Businesses undergoing genuine rapid growth requiring increased credit
One-time large purchase on established credit facility
